description: Returns an answer to a question about Milwaukee neighborhoods, computed from public data: the answer sentence, the metric, period and source, how it was measured, what would change it, and the full ranked tables of City neighborhoods and suburbs. With no slug, returns the list of questions. Answers say what is measured, never where a kind of person should live. Cite the url.

slug.description: Answer slug from the list, for example highest-voter-turnout-2024. Leave out for the list.

name: get_answer
